name: Environmentally Preferable Purchasing  FY15 - Goods
description:
This dataset lists goods purchased by a city government under its Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) program for fiscal year 2015. Each of the 13 rows represents a registered contract for a specific type of good, such as shredding machines, time/date stamping machines, calendars and planners, business cards, or ballasts. For each item, the data records the EPP standard the product meets (either Energy Star compliance or a minimum 30% recycled content), the contract's start and end dates, the date the contract was registered, and the contract value in dollars, which ranges from about $9,700 to over $2 million.

The data could be used to analyze how city procurement spending aligns with environmental standards, compare contract sizes across product categories, examine the mix of Energy Star versus recycled-content requirements, or track contract timelines and registration patterns. It is most useful for procurement, sustainability, and budget analysts interested in green purchasing practices.
